OPTIONAL UX: Provide deep-link support for Settings tabs (e.g. ?tab=integrations) so /settings/integrations or query param resolves the right tab. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: telephony._cfg now correctly prepends 'https://' when scheme is missing — guards against the original httpx parse failure and the Cloudflare 520 path.
test_tcx route correctly maps ValueError/RuntimeError → 400 and other exceptions → 502 with a truncated message; good UX.
dial_contact correctly checks tcx_enabled and opted_out/do_not_call BEFORE invoking telephony; ordering and HTTP codes are appropriate (400 for client/business errors).

rca of the issue: Original bug: tcx_url like 'citiq.3cx.co.za:5001' (no scheme) caused httpx.AsyncClient.post(f'{base}/connect/token') to construct an invalid request URL, which (depending on routing) propagated as a Cloudflare 520 'invalid/incomplete response'. Fix in /app/backend/telephony.py _cfg(): if base is truthy and does not startswith ('http://','https://'), prepend 'https://'. Verified by running the same Test connection flow with the no-scheme URL and observing a 200 OK with device_count=1.
